Six comments

Bold Doherty

This is the jig version of the song recorded by Dervish, amongst others (for a clip, go here http://www.mp3sale.ru/track.php?ms_trackid=118032). There’s a similar tune here already which is probably based on the same song, but there are significant differences in the B-part to warrant a separate posting, I think https://thesession.org/tunes/2680. The version I’ve posted is based on the setting on Angelina Carberry’s “An Traidisiun Beo”.

Here’s the version I recorded at a session when I first heard the tune a few years ago, before I heard Angelina Carberry’s recording:

Bold Doherty (song)

Fermanagh singer and concertina player Gabriel McArdle sings the song on “Jig Away the Donkey: Music and Song of South Ulster” CD. The notes read:

Gabriel learned this song from Drogheda singer, Sean Corcoran. The song mentions Doherty passinng through Gabriel’s hometown of Enniskillen. Sean collected the song from Mary Ann Carolan from Tinure, Co. Louth in the early 1970’s.
